# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 880 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com

## Machine-readable catalog

- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): full catalog
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)

- [Jupyter MCP Server](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/jupyter-mcp-server.html) (added 2026-10-18): Datalayer's MCP server that lets AI agents connect to and manage Jupyter notebooks in real time, local or hosted.
- [CodeGraphContext](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/codegraphcontext.html) (added 2026-10-18): MCP server and CLI that index local code into a graph database so AI assistants can query code relationships.
- [Postgres MCP Pro](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/postgres-mcp-pro.html) (added 2026-10-18): Postgres MCP server with index tuning, explain plans, health checks and safe SQL execution for agents.
- [LINE Bot MCP Server](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/line-bot-mcp-server.html) (added 2026-10-18): LINE's preview MCP server that connects an AI agent to a LINE Official Account through the Messaging API.
- [Sentry MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/sentry-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): Sentry's MCP server and CLI that give coding agents access to Sentry issues, errors and traces for debugging.
- [Next.js DevTools MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/next-js-devtools-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): Vercel's MCP server that connects coding agents to running Next.js dev servers for live errors, routes, logs and docs.
- [Firefox DevTools MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/firefox-devtools-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): Mozilla's MCP server that lets AI agents browse with Firefox and inspect pages with its developer tools over WebDriver BiDi.
- [MotherDuck MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/motherduck-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): MotherDuck's MCP server that lets AI assistants run SQL on local DuckDB files, S3-hosted databases and MotherDuck.
- [Kagi MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/kagi-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): Official Kagi MCP server with search and page-extraction tools backed by the Kagi API.
- [dbt MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/dbt-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): dbt Labs' MCP server that gives AI agents context and tools for dbt Core, dbt Fusion and dbt Platform projects.
- [Cloud Run MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/cloud-run-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): Google Cloud's MCP server and Gemini CLI extension that lets AI agents deploy apps to Cloud Run.
- [Azure DevOps MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/azure-devops-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): Microsoft's MCP server that gives AI agents access to Azure DevOps work items, repos, pipelines and more, local or hosted.
